challengeFindings.title: A plan whose matrix header omits the closing pipe (`| Test description | Type | Target file | Task`) passes plan-check with every matrix check switched off, so a row naming an undefined task (or no row for a test-bearing task) is no longer refused

challengeFindings.title: A plan refused only for its matrix header gets a header-only fix ("Fix only what ... names; edit only those lines"), its rows keep the old cell order, and plan-check then reads a backticked target file such as `t1.test.ts` as `TASK 1`, so the misaligned matrix passes mapped to the wrong tasks, or fails a second time and sends the plan workflow to the Failure Path
